# watchpoint_alert_routing_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a single alert routing rule by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_alert_routing_rule" "after_hours" {
  name = "After-hours criticals to the on-call lead"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the alert routing rule to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Alert routing rule ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order, ascending.
- `stop_processing` (Boolean) Whether a match stops lower-priority rules from being evaluated.
